== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Luke eligibility is recast from ability less than 6 to non-Jedi. The separate weapon-destiny branch still targets Luke; the duel and lightsaber combat branches expressly need him participating. The period rules distinguish interaction in a duel from weapon targeting. Same two weapons, 1 Force and Unless Inner Strength limits.
